title: Authoritative course facts conflict across owned channels
agent_position: The agent does not decide which value is correct from the web. This is routed as an opportunity, not a violation: confirm the current scorecard, yardage and green surface with the Director of Golf, then update the source of truth and downstream listings (booking engines, aggregators, AI answers).
why_it_matters: Externally visible, cheap to fix, and directly affects customer trust, search results and booking expectations.
